message:
Ever been caught in a blackout with no flashlight and a fridge full of leftovers? 🙈 I can’t tell you how many times I’ve wished I had a little more prep in my back pocket for those unexpected power outages. It’s kind of like that moment when you realize you’re out of snacks during a movie marathon—definitely not ideal! 

There’s a great resource I found that offers some practical tips for handling power outages, from keeping your food safe to staying entertained. Remember, a little preparedness can turn an inconvenient moment into a cozy adventure. 

What’s your favorite tip for staying ready when the lights go out?
